locked.say: Shift+A unlocks in Lesson 02. Patience, grasshopper.

bites.title: New eyes
bites.body: Same cube, but now you have a header and a toolbar. This lesson is about HOW you look at your scene: as wire, as clay, as paint, as light.

bites.title: See through it
bites.body: Hover the viewport and press Z. A pie menu blooms around your mouse. Flick toward Wireframe.
bites.hint: Press Z, slide the mouse toward the word Wireframe, and click.
bites.praise: Pure skeleton. Every edge, no skin.

bites.title: Back to clay
bites.body: Z again, and this time pick Solid. Solid is home base: fast, clear, no surprises.

bites.title: X-ray vision
bites.body: Press Alt+Z. Solid turns ghostly, so you can see and click things hiding behind other things. Then press Alt+Z again to turn it off.
bites.hint: Alt+Z toggles it. On, then off.

bites.title: Paint preview
bites.body: Z, then Material Preview. Now you see colors and textures under a studio light. The first time takes a moment while Blender warms up its shaders.

bites.title: The truth
bites.body: Look at the top-right of the header: four little spheres. They're the same four shading modes. Click the last one: Rendered. Real lights, real shadows.
bites.hint: Top-right corner of the header, the sphere farthest to the right.

bites.title: Home again
bites.body: Click the second sphere in the header to come back to Solid. Rendered is gorgeous but hungry.

bites.title: Clean slate
bites.body: Shift+Alt+Z hides every helper drawing: the grid, the axis lines, the orange outline. Press it once to see your scene bare, then again to bring the helpers back.
bites.hint: Shift+Alt+Z, twice. Or click the button with two overlapping circles in the header.

bites.title: T for tools
bites.body: The tall strip on the left is the toolbar. Press T to tuck it away, then T again to bring it back.
bites.hint: Mouse over the viewport, then T. Twice.

bites.title: N for numbers
bites.body: Press N. A sidebar slides out on the right with tabs: Item, Tool, View. Item shows the exact numbers behind whatever is selected.
bites.hint: Mouse over the viewport, then N.
bites.praise: Every object is secretly a spreadsheet.

bites.title: Type a position
bites.body: In the sidebar's Item tab, find Location X. Double-click it, type 1, press Enter. The cube jumps to exactly one meter.
bites.hint: Item tab, Transform, Location, the X field. Double-click to type into it.

bites.title: Ask Blender
bites.body: Hover the mouse over that same Location field and press F1. A plain-language card explains it. This works on almost anything: buttons, fields, even objects in the viewport.
bites.praise: You'll never be lost in here again.

bites.title: Lesson 01: cleared
bites.body:
Wireframe, Solid, Material Preview, Rendered. X-ray, overlays, toolbar, sidebar, typed numbers, and F1. You can SEE now.

Reward: Shift+A, the Add menu. Scroll on for Lesson 02: Making.
